items: capture-render-quality-v1 items 2+3 A/B (Depth Anything V2 Small prior + depth/normal losses)
privacy: Metrics and text only. Bedroom splats/renders stay on the box (chmod 700) and the private volume; the prior maps lived only in the run's temp dir; no bedroom geometry panels were written (AUTH #046).
setup: quality-30k, antialiased, default densification, 400K budget, L40S, launched 19:17 CT from 8261c90. dn weights: Pearson(inverse depth vs DA-V2-Small disparity) 0.2, depth-normal consistency 0.1, normal TV 0.05, from step 500, alpha>0.5 mask. Pre-registered rule in items2-3-ab-plan.json.

decision.rule: flip depth_prior on only if, on every evaluated room, the floater proxy drops AND LPIPS worsens by <= +0.005, AND mean PSNR change >= -0.3 dB
decision.result: FAILS on every room. LPIPS worsens +0.225 (Winchester), +0.241 (Eldon), +0.042 (bedroom); PSNR -3.57 / -5.39 / -0.53 dB. Floater proxy drops on Winchester (-47%) and the bedroom (-48%) but rises on Eldon (+9%).
decision.notable: Bedroom through the Unity path improves: 22.10 vs 21.71 dB vs ground truth, and Unity-vs-gsplat agreement rises 25.62 -> 27.36 dB. The dn splat has ~95% fewer isolated and ~90% fewer giant splats, which the phone renderer handles badly. The geometry signal is real, but at these weights it costs too much appearance.
decision.diagnosis_open: The corpus collapse (-3.6/-5.4 dB) is far larger than DN-Splatter reports. Suspects to check on CPU before any more GPU: (1) prior weights too strong for 30K/400K (Pearson 0.2 from step 500; one corpus room started at raw Pearson loss ~0.95 = near-zero correlation); (2) prior/frame misalignment from nerfstudio's undistortion crop (the prior is computed on the raw distorted frame); (3) normal consistency against upsampled ~518-px prior normals over-smoothing detail. Next attempt: weights /4, start at 3-5K steps, sample-check DA-V2 disparity sign/alignment on box CPU.

geometry_panels: ns_finish --geometry-renders failed in-container (pipeline left in train mode after eval -> SplatfactoModel.optimizers missing); fixed in this branch (pipeline.eval()). The corpus sanity panel is rendered on the box CPU from the downloaded PLYs instead.

owner_share_image.what: Winchester held-out view (COLMAP image index 72), 480 px: rows = no prior / with prior; columns = splat RGB (SH DC) | inverse depth (turbo) | normals from rendered depth. Rendered on the box CPU from the downloaded 400K PLYs (gsplat 1.4.0 projection + tile intersection, CPU torch front-to-back compositing with antialiased compensation; script /workspace/gj-pipe03/geom_panel.py).
owner_share_image.reading: Without the prior the depth and normals are full of floater speckle but the structure is right (far wall, nearer pillars). With the prior the wall becomes a smooth plane and the speckle disappears, but the depth is flattened into a bowl (wall/pillar separation lost) and the RGB smears (doors and figures ghost). So the losses regularise geometry as intended, but the prior/weights override photometric detail.
